using Makie

function makeplot(x, mu, sigma)
    fig = Figure(size=(640, 400))
    ax = Axis(fig[1, 1]; xlabel="Time", ylabel="Value", title="Estimate")

    # Create the mean line
    mean_line = Line(x, mu; color=:blue, label="Mean")

    # Create the semi-transparent blue band
    # We create two lines for the upper and lower bounds
    upper_line = Line(x, mu .+ sigma; color=:blue, linewidth=2, alpha=0.3)
    lower_line = Line(x, mu .- sigma; color=:blue, linewidth=2, alpha=0.3)

    # Add lines to the axis
    ax[mean_line]
    ax[upper_line]
    ax[lower_line]

    # Add legend
    ax.legend(position=:lt)

    return fig, ax
end
